user.title: Add a TVT camera
user.description: Use the bridge built into Home Assistant, or the optional TVT Archive app or container.

remote.title: Connect to the TVT Archive app
remote.description: Enter the address of the TVT Archive app or container and its access token. The token can be left empty for an app that is already connected.

pick.title: Choose a camera
pick.description: This bridge already knows these cameras.

adopt.title: Log in to {camera}
adopt.description: Enter the camera's login. Home Assistant keeps it so the camera can be restored if the bridge loses its settings.

camera.title: Add camera
camera.description: The camera is tested before it is saved.

reauth_confirm.title: Update login for {camera}
reauth_confirm.description: The camera rejected its username or password.

reauth_token.title: Update access token
reauth_token.description: The bridge rejected the stored access token. Print the current one with `docker exec tvt-archive tvt-archive show-token`.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure camera
reconfigure.description: Leave the password blank to keep it.

hassio_confirm.title: TVT Archive app
hassio_confirm.description: Add a camera through the TVT Archive app?

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or authenticate to the bridge
error.camera_connection_failed: The bridge could not log in to or query this camera. Check its address, port, username, and password.
error.camera_auth_failed: The camera rejected this username or password.
error.camera_busy: Wait for this camera's playback or download to finish and try again.
error.already_configured: Another entry already uses this camera address

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up
abort.already_in_progress: This camera is already being set up
abort.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not connect to the TVT Archive bridge
abort.camera_not_found: The camera is no longer configured on the bridge
abort.builtin_failed: The built-in bridge could not start. Check the Home Assistant log; ffmpeg must be installed.

init.title: Motion sensors for {camera_name}
init.description: Shown on the timeline when the camera's recordings carry no motion events. Sensors from other integrations using the same address are preselected.

sd_card.title: {camera} has a problem with its SD card
sd_card.description: {camera} reports {state}, so its recordings are unavailable. Check or replace the card in the camera's settings.

ffmpeg_missing.title: TVT Archive needs ffmpeg
ffmpeg_missing.description: The built-in bridge could not find ffmpeg. Install ffmpeg on the Home Assistant host, or use the TVT Archive app instead.

save_recording.name: Save recording
save_recording.description: Saves a recording from a camera's SD card as an MP4 in the media folder.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the recording. Leave empty to save the most recent footage.

filename.name: File name
filename.description: Saved under media/tvt_archive. Defaults to the camera name and time.
